text: We evaluated 120 patients with type 2 diabetes using continuous glucose monitoring. Participants received metformin treatment for 12 weeks. Changes in fasting blood glucose and HbA1c levels were measured throughout the study.

A cohort of 84 adults with obesity participated in a randomized controlled trial. Participants received either a high-protein diet or a standard diet for 16 weeks. Body weight and insulin sensitivity were assessed before and after the intervention.

Thirty-six healthy volunteers completed a crossover study investigating the effects of caffeine supplementation. Participants consumed either 200 mg of caffeine or placebo before exercise testing. Heart rate and exercise performance were recorded.
